verdict.rationale: Mercury offers scattered AI automation features (AI reads bills and auto-fills details, AI-powered bookkeeping automation) but no evidence of a single built-in conversational AI assistant inside the product to which a user delegates arbitrary tasks; the natural-language 'What's my balance' capability is delivered via the external MCP server (for third-party AI clients like Claude/ChatGPT) rather than an assistant embedded in Mercury's own UI. Missing for 10: a dedicated in-app AI assistant/chat interface, evidence of multi-step task delegation, and independent hands-on confirmation of these AI features working as described.
